title: Mirai_Botnet_Investigation_999
description: Investigate unusual traffic patterns and performance degradation in the network.

levels.title: Introduction
levels.content: The network has experienced unusual traffic patterns and performance degradation. Your task is to investigate and identify the source of these issues. The malware family involved is Mirai, a well-known IoT botnet.

levels.title: Get Access
levels.cloud_content: You have SSH access to the bot1 host with the following credentials: Username: cyrano, Password: cyrano
levels.local_content: You have SSH access to the bot1 host with the following credentials: Username: cyrano, Password: cyrano

levels.title: Suspicious Beacon Service Discovery
levels.content: Investigate the bot1 host and identify an unauthorized or suspicious service responsible for periodic external communication.
levels.solution: Check running services and systemd timers for unusual activity. Look for the bot-beacon.timer and bot-beacon.service. The flag type is a service name.

hints.title: First hint title
hints.content: Check running services and systemd timers for unusual activity.

hints.title: Second hint title
hints.content: Look for the bot-beacon.timer and bot-beacon.service.

levels.title: C2 Communication Discovery (IP Address)
levels.content: Determine the external host communicating with the compromised system.
levels.solution: Examine network connections and logs for external communication patterns. Check the beacon.log file for the C2 server IP address. The flag type is an IP address.

hints.title: First hint title
hints.content: Examine network connections and logs for external communication patterns.

hints.title: Second hint title
hints.content: Check the beacon.log file for the C2 server IP address.

levels.title: Flood Attack Target Identification
levels.content: Identify the system receiving the abnormal volume of network traffic generated by the compromised host.
levels.solution: Review network traffic logs to identify the target of the flood attack. Check the flood.log file for the target IP address. The flag type is an IP address.

hints.title: First hint title
hints.content: Review network traffic logs to identify the target of the flood attack.

hints.content: Check the flood.log file for the target IP address.
